newsitem.title: KENYA: Coffee prices firmer at Kenyan auction.
newsitem.headline: Coffee prices firmer at Kenyan auction.

text.p: Coffee prices for grades AA's and AB's were slightly stronger while other grades held steady at the weekly export auction on Tuesday, traders said

A senior official from Coffee Auctions Ltd said the market was slightly firmer than last week. Premiums grades AA's averaged $131.5 per 50 kg bag against $129 last week, AB's rose to $125.5 from $119.5 while C's averaged $118.5 from 119.5.
"Grades ABs and AAs were a little stronger while other grades held steady," the auction official told Reuters.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 33,060 60-kg bags it offered, compared to 40,804 sold last week.
